annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 1 year on most years; older 4.2L V8 and V10 TDI models hold more oil
maint.note: Use the VW oil standard listed for your engine (diesels need 507.00).
These are heavy vehicles; rotors are often replaced with the pads. V10 TDI brakes cost more.
The electronic parking brake must be put in service mode with a scan tool.
The battery is under the driver seat on many Touaregs, and it must be registered with a scan tool on later models.

maint.every: About every 40,000–60,000 miles on gasoline engines; diesels have glow plugs instead
maint.note: RepairPal lists Touareg spark plug replacement at about $304–$380.

maint.every: No fixed interval in VW's schedule; check level and protection at each service
maint.note: RepairPal lists a Touareg coolant change at about $625–$708.
